request.prompt: You are helping a hotel engineering team. Describe what is visible in 2-3 sentences, focusing on any safety or maintenance issue. Then add one sentence starting 'Unsure:' saying what you cannot tell from the image.

response.text:
This image shows a large gray mechanical unit (likely an air handling unit or similar HVAC equipment) in a utility/basement area, with overhead piping and ductwork running along the ceiling. A significant water leak is visible, with liquid pooling extensively on the concrete floor beneath and in front of the unit, indicating a possible drain pan overflow, condensate line blockage, or pipe leak that requires prompt attention to prevent water damage or slip hazards.

Unsure: I cannot determine the exact source of the leak (whether it's from the unit itself, a connecting pipe, or condensate drainage), how long the leak has been occurring, or whether it poses an electrical hazard given the unit's proximity to the standing water.
